title: Abyssals v0.90.21 — Uncapped Catch-Up XP
notes: Removes the level-gap XP ceiling and adds the approved quadratic catch-up formula: round((25 + 5d + d²/48) × progression bonus × Warbond × species yield). A level-1 partner defeating a level-150 ordinary opponent with Warbond receives 4,930 XP, reaching level 50 with 30 XP remaining. Binoculars award full individual XP to each eligible living party member. Weaker-opponent penalties, level-200 maximum, saves, shiny artwork, permanent death and quest progress preserved. Built and verified through GitHub Actions using the original Android signing key. Automated tests; no physical-phone testing.
